title: Pook Hustle releases his highly anticipated track titled “Mental Health”
htmlContent:
"Mental Health" is a relatable track that touches on the challenges of dealing with mental health issues. Pook Hustle talks about his struggles with anxiety and depression and how he's learned to cope with them. He also urges his listeners to seek help if they are experiencing similar struggles, emphasizing the importance of speaking up and seeking support.

The track departs from Pook Hustle's usual braggadocious style, showing the artist's more introspective side. His vulnerability in "Mental Health" is refreshing and adds to the depth of the song. It's a powerful reminder that mental health issues can affect anyone, regardless of background or success.

Overall, "Mental Health" is a must-listen for anyone who has ever struggled with their mental health or knows someone who has. Pook Hustle's willingness to share his own experiences is a testament to his commitment to using his platform to promote awareness and encourage conversations around mental health. With this track, Pook Hustle has cemented himself as a rising star to watch in the music industry.
